rss: Ryanair says it may freeze workers' pay and raise airfares
title: Airfare Costs May Go Up
story: FIZZ Airlines thinks it might have to make airplane tickets more expensive because the fuel they need might cost more soon.
storyBig: FIZZ Airlines is concerned about rising fuel prices, which could increase their operating costs significantly, leading to higher ticket prices for travelers.
think: What happens if the cost of flying gets too high?
bull: More people might travel by FIZZ Airlines if they keep prices steady.
bear: Costly tickets could mean fewer people choose to fly.

rss: Shop freezers in seven European countries hit by suspected cyber-attack
title: Temperature Trouble in Ice Cream Town
story: The ice cream makers in Sweetland had a problem with their freezers! They got too warm, and the ice cream melted.
storyBig: ICEE, the ice cream company, faced a technical malfunction that caused their freezers to overheat, leading to a temporary disruption in maintaining product quality.
think: What do you think happens to ice cream when it melts and refreezes?
bull: It's a good time to try new flavors while they restock!
bear: Melted ice cream might not taste as good.
